# Mill village housing kit 3: one sample row of 8 modules

## SITE

- Row 96 wide (x 0..95), 19 deep (z 0..18). Front faces NORTH (-z), the lane side; x runs along the lane. Same grid as kits 1 and 2.
1:# Mill village housing kit 3: one sample row of 8 modules
3:## SITE
61:## ROOFS
72:| 3 tower | tall pyramid/cone cap | `tower-cap`, material `copper` palette (weathered/oxidized), finial lightning_rod | apex over x 44..45 z 8..9 | eaves y 16, apex y 22 | 1 (x 42..47, z 6..11) | sits on the tower stage top y 15 |
84:## FACADES
88:**Plot 0 double shotgun (x 1..10):** piers `bricks`, skirting `birch_trapdoor` lattice. Walls `light_blue_terracotta` (dusty-blue clapboard) y 3..6 and the front gable triangle; corner boards + head plate `stripped_birch_log` (white); a white frieze board `birch_slab` (top) under the front eave. Front (z 9), symmetrical about the party wall: doors x 4 and x 7 (both `bamboo_door`, tall: door y 3..4 + glass_pane transom y 5), windows x 2 and x 9 (1x3 floor-length, y 3..5, the New Orleans "shotgun" window) with `dark_oak_trapdoor` shutters full height on the OUTER side of each window only, at x 1 and x 10 (z 8, y 3..5). Party wall x 5..6 shows on the front as a 2-wide white pilaster `stripped_birch_log` y 3..6. Gable: 2-wide louvred vent `birch_trapdoor` (open) x 5..6 y 9, a sunburst of birch_slab rays round it. Porch: deck `dark_oak_planks` y 2; posts `stripped_birch_log` y 3..6 at x 1, 4, 7, 10 (z 7) — the steps x 5..6 between the two middle posts; beam `stripped_birch_log` axis x y 6; gingerbread brackets `birch_stairs` upside-down under the beam each side of each post; rail `birch_fence` y 3 except x 5..6. Sides x 1 / x 10: windows at z 11 and z 15 (z 12 and z 14 stay solid for the bed heads). Back (z 16): back doors x 2 and x 9, the twin stack between them.
92:**Plot 2 American Foursquare (x 27..34):** brick foundation `bricks` y 1..2 continuous (no piers: a 1910s house). Walls `yellow_terracotta` (ochre clapboard) y 3..11; corner boards `stripped_birch_log`; a white belt course `birch_slab` (top) at y 7 flush round all four sides (the floor line); a frieze board `stripped_birch_log` axis x/z at y 11 under the deep eave. Front (z 9): door x 30 (`spruce_door`, y 3..4) with a glass sidelight x 29 (y 3..4) and transom y 5 x 29..30; window x 28; a 2-wide window x 32..33 (y 4..5). Upper (z 9): windows x 28..29 and x 32..33 (2-wide pairs, y 9..10). Dormer (z 10 face): windows x 30..31 y 13, walls `yellow_terracotta`, corners birch. Porch: deck `dark_oak_planks` y 2; columns at x 27 and x 34 and x 31 (z 7): `bricks` pedestal y 3, `stripped_birch_log` square column y 4..5, beam `stripped_birch_log` y 6; balustrade `birch_fence` y 3 except steps x 29..30; brick cheeks (brick_wall) each side of the steps at x 28 and x 31 z 6. Sides: west x 27 windows z 10 and z 15 (y 4..5) and z 10, z 15 (y 9..10), chimney between at z 11..13; east x 34 windows z 11, z 14 both storeys. Back (z 16): door x 32 (to a slab stoop z 17), windows x 29 y 4..5, x 29 and x 32 y 9..10.
102:**Plot 7 company duplex (x 85..94):** foundation `bricks` y 1..2 continuous. Walls `bricks` y 3..11, a `stone_bricks` water table y 2 and `smooth_stone_slab` (top) sills; lintels: `stone_brick_slab` (top) flush over every opening; a `stone_bricks` belt y 7; cornice `stone_brick_stairs` upside-down facing out under the eave y 11, proud 1. Party wall shows on the front as a 2-wide brick pier x 89..90 rising full height. Front (z 9), mirrored: doors x 88 and x 91 (`dark_oak_door`, y 3..4, transom y 5); windows x 86..87 and x 92..93 (2 wide, y 4..5); upper: doors x 88 and x 91 (y 8..9) out to the gallery, windows x 86..87 and x 92..93 (y 9..10). Two-storey porch: square 1x1 brick piers `bricks` y 3..11 at x 85, 89, 90, 94 (z 7) — the middle pair x 89..90 divides the two families' porches; lower deck `dark_oak_planks` y 2, gallery deck `dark_oak_planks` y 7 over z 7..8 (its underside the lower porch ceiling); railings `birch_fence` y 3 (gap x 88 and x 91 = each unit's step) and y 8 full; a solid `bricks` divider on the gallery at x 89..90 already the pier. Sides x 85 / x 94: windows z 11 and z 14 both storeys. Back (z 16): blank brick behind the two stacks x 86..88 / x 91..93; no back door (light from the side windows).
104:## MATERIALS
113:| 0 walls / trim / shutters / door / rail | light_blue_terracotta / stripped_birch_log + birch_slab + birch_stairs / dark_oak_trapdoor / bamboo_door / birch_fence |
126:| light | lantern (hanging under porch ceilings, from loft/ceiling beams, standing on fence posts and tables) |
130:## OPENINGS
148:| 2 | front door / sidelight / transom | door x 30 y 3..4; sidelight x 29 y 3..4; transom x 29..30 y 5; z 9 |
180:## RESERVED
187:| stair flights (flight(): top step IN the upper floor y 7) | 2: x 33, z 15→11 facing north, steps y 3..7, hole in floor y 7 x 33 z 11..14, step out at z 10, rail x 32 z 11..14 y 8; 3: x 44, z 15→11 facing north, hole y 7 x 44 z 11..14, landing z 10 (lit by the stained window); 4 (attic): x 54, z 15→11 facing north, hole y 7 x 54 z 11..14, out at z 10; 7 west: x 88, z 15→11 facing north, hole y 7 x 88 z 11..14; 7 east: x 91, z 15→11 facing north, hole y 7 x 91 z 11..14; 5 loft: ladder on the inside of the west wall x 62, z 14, y 1..6, hole in the loft floor (62, 6, 14) | stairs |
197:## FLOORS
225:# DESIGNER SECTIONS (below the architect's form; nothing above is changed)
227:Corrections to ids (checked with `$MCD blocks --check`): the architect's `red_nether_brick`, `nether_brick`, `mud_brick` mean the plural full blocks **`red_nether_bricks`, `nether_bricks`, `mud_bricks`** (their `_stairs`/`_slab` keep the singular: `red_nether_brick_stairs`, `nether_brick_slab`, `mud_brick_stairs`). `chain` is `iron_chain`. Walls of `light_blue_terracotta`, `yellow_terracotta`, `cyan_terracotta` are the architect's; keep.
229:## PALETTE
235:- Walls: 0 light_blue_terracotta; 1 cherry_planks (+cherry_slab); 2 yellow_terracotta; 3 crimson_planks, birch_planks + birch_slab (fishscale); 4 cyan_terracotta; 5 stripped_dark_oak_log + stripped_spruce_log; 6 stripped_oak_log; 7 bricks.
240:- Fire/functional: campfire (lit true, signal_fire true), hay_block, furnace (lit), smoker (lit), iron_trapdoor (optional thin flue wall), cauldron, water_cauldron, composter, smithing_table, barrel, ladder, iron_chain, lantern, lightning_rod, white_wool, hay (hay_block bales), bell none.
244:## VOCABULARY
249:- `lamp_post(g, x)`: spruce_fence y1..3 at z4 + standing lantern y4 (hanging false).
263:- `stair_run(g, from, facing, toY, material, width)` = `flight()`; top step flush in the upper floor layer y7; rail on the open side with a gap at the top.
285:## ROOMS
287:Floors: jungle_planks (houses; ground floor block y2, stand y3; upper floor block y7, stand y8), barn spruce loft y6. Every room lantern-lit (hanging from the head plate or tie beam, standing lanterns on tables), floor light >= 8. Boxes are inner air. Some architect doorway positions had to be resolved by the designer (noted per room).

304:| P2 kitchen | 31,3,13, 32,6,15 | stove at (31,3,15); back door x32 z16; cupboard under the flight x33 |
310:| P3 stair hall | 42,3,10, 44,6,13 | double door x41..42 z9 (x42 is its cell); flight x44 z15->11; arch (43,3,14) |
311:| P3 kitchen-dining | 40,3,14, 43,6,15 | hearth mouth (41,3,16), stove (41,3,15), table; back door x44 z16 opens onto the flight foot (44,3,15); opening x42..43 z13 from the hall |
320:| P4 stair strip | 54,3,10, 54,6,15 | flight x54 z15->11, step out (54,3,10)->(54,8,10) |
328:| P7 west parlour | 86,3,10, 88,6,12 | bed head (86,3,10) foot (87,3,10) west; front door x88 z9; door x86 z13 to kitchen; flight starts x88 z15 |
332:| P7 east parlour / kitchen / bedrooms | 91,3,10, 93,6,12 / 92,3,14, 93,6,15 / 91,8,10, 93,11,12 / 92,8,14, 93,11,15 | mirror of the west unit: beds heads x93 facing east; door x93 z13; hearth (92,3,16); flight x91 |
337:## PARTS
339:1. **Shell A, plots 0-3**: `parts/shell_a.mjs`. Piers/foundations, decks, ground and upper floors (leave stair holes), walls with corner boards and plates, partitions, stair flights, tower stages, every opening left AIR.
344:6. **Grounds and yards**: `parts/grounds.mjs`. Lane, lamp posts, fences, gates, paths, paddock, trough, composter, hay, garden beds, rain barrels, wagon, benches, planting.

make.sh rebuilds build.nbt cleanly with the Roofs part placing 1526 blocks; the light check ran on that build.

The gambrel-beam hanging lantern over the aisle is not placed: it is only needed if the dark count rises, and it did not.
